title: Crutch Rate by Payer Class and Campus — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Payer agreement term.** The crutches (code E0114 under revenue code 0274) on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), carry a rate per counted unit of:
- 31.50 USD when a Commercial PPO Claim is for services at Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute;
- 36.00 USD when a Commercial HMO Claim is for services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah);
- otherwise, their charges per counted unit times the expected allowed percentage.

They are valued at their counted units times that rate, never above their charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

| Hypothetical case | Value |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim at Grand Chute, 2 units, charges 90.00 | 63.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim at Appleton, 1 unit, charges 90.00 | 36.00 |
| Commercial PPO Claim at Neenah, 1 unit, charges 90.00 | expected allowed percentage of 90.00 |
